title: Google Willow logical qubits stabilized by continuous RL control: d=7 surface code at 7.72e-4 err/cycle
summary: Autonomous RL agent (PPO over ~1,000 control parameters, trained on error-detection signals) holds logical qubits stable during continuous operation: d=7 surface code 7.72(9)e-4 and d=5 color code 8.19(14)e-3 logical errors/cycle; 3.5x stability gain and 20% extra LER suppression beyond expert calibration; scaling sims flat to d=15 (~40k params).

key_specs.gain: 3.5x stability, +20% LER suppression vs expert calibration

actionable: Strengthens the always-on logical-qubit assumption in any digital-FT MERA/Ising budget (HYP-2026-029 class): continuous operation without recalibration downtime is exactly what a long force-measurement sequence needs.
